title: European nations at the 2026 World Cup
brief: Name any of the 16 UEFA nations that played at the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Italy: Italy did not qualify: they lost the play-off final to Bosnia and Herzegovina on penalties.
notes.Republic of Ireland: The Republic of Ireland did not qualify for 2026.
notes.Northern Ireland: Northern Ireland did not qualify for 2026.
notes.West Germany: The 2026 team is Germany; West Germany last played in 1990.

checks: The 16 UEFA qualifiers agree between the 2026 World Cup article's qualified teams list and the UEFA qualification article's qualified teams table (12 group winners plus 4 play-off winners: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Sweden, Turkey, Czech Republic). Bosnia and Herzegovina is not in nations.txt yet.
